notes:
- Comments now have a real editor, with formatting and a preview: the comment box opens a full editor with Write/Preview modes, bold/italic/spoiler markers, a character counter, an attach-image dialog, and a Reply action that starts the draft with the author's @name.
- A repeated comment id can no longer crash a thread: the list and the post response are collapsed to one entry per id, and the scroll to a new comment is looked up by id.
- Your AniList token is encrypted on the device now: The token is protected by a key that never leaves the Android keystore, existing sessions migrate once, and an invalidated key asks you to sign in again instead of failing every launch.
- An optional app lock keeps your list private: Settings > Edit has a Lock AniSequel switch using your fingerprint, face or screen lock, with the recents preview blanked while locked.
- A throttled empty answer can no longer wipe your list: an empty list response is refused when the app already holds a populated one, so a temporary failure no longer looks like a deleted account.
- Title pages cache by release status: finished shows for a week, airing ones for three hours, unreleased for six, and a passed airing time overrides the window.
- A pull-to-refresh is no longer treated like a background check: five seconds for a gesture, fifteen for an automatic resume.
- A malformed image size in a bio can no longer crash the page, and parsed bios are cached across scrolls.
- Widgets decode covers inside a display-derived memory budget, answer instantly from a warm cover cache, and hand the launcher software bitmaps.
- A huge error response can no longer exhaust memory: error bodies are read up to 64 KB.
